body.value: Specifications "White" 1896 Model A.
Frame. High diamond pattern; 1¼ inch
cold drawn seamless steel tubing, 1
inch top bar, height, 24 or 26 inches, %
inch tubing in rear forks, ¾ inch tubing
in rear upright forks
Frame Parts. All steel drop forgings, strong-
ly reinforced at connections.
Forks. Seamless steel fork sides, gracefully
curved and mechanically reinforced.
Double fork crown.
Steering Head. 9 inches long, 1¼ inches in
diameter.
Handle Bar. Cold drawn weldless steel, tube
⅛ inches in diameter, adjustable to four
positions. Our own invention. Brake
will be furnished with stationary bar
when specially ordered
Handles. Cork or corkaline, white composi-
tion tips.
Wheels. 28 inches front and rear.
Wheel Base. 43 inches.
Rims. Kundtz, triple reinforced wood rims.
Tires. Choice of Vim, Morgan & Wright, New
York, Palmer, North American or Good-
rich.
Spokes. Swaged piano wire, 28 in front, 36
in rear. Swaged, .080 to .oo.
Pedals. Grothe or Brandenburg, rat trap or
rubber. Dust proof centers and bearings.
Cranks. Special steel, round and tapered,
with throw 6½ inches long.
Chain. ¼ inch solid link with hardened rivet
and steel centers.
Saddles. Sager or Kells saddle in black leather.
Saddle Post. Style "T." "L" or direct seat
post.
Tread. 5 inches.
Sprocket Wheels. Both detachable, steel drop
forgings, hardened. Front sprocket
overhangs crank bracket, bringing chain
directly over ball race.
Gear. 68 regular, 64 or 72 furnished if so
desired
Bearings. Made of best selected high-grade
tool steel, carefully tempered and dust
proof. A far superior construction of
the crank bearing to any ever before used.
Patent applied for.
Hubs. Large tubular hubs, made from solid
bar steel.
Furnishings. Tool bag, wrench, oiler, pump,
repair kit. Saddle and tool bag in black
leather.
Finish. Handle bar, hubs, sprocket wheels,
cranks, pedals, seat post, spokes, screws,
nuts, washers, nickle plated over copper.
Fork crown in white enamel with gold
edge, remainder black enamel.
Weight, 22 pounds with Fittings. Price, $100.00.
